related_gaps.rationale: Workflow tooling does not define acceptance for an adopted product.
Local tooling does not configure hosting rules.
Unchanged: next advises and never gates, so order is still checked only for complete tasks; the reference page re-observed this (note on order) and next cannot flag it earlier without a base.

gap_review: Reviewed the four open gaps at task start and again before completion; this change adds advisory routing and a stop-hook base, and closes or reopens none of them.

discoveries.summary: Skill frontmatter can register hooks, grant tools and run shell commands at load, so skills act as policy; the requested carve-out of .claude/skills from the ceremony list was dropped and skills stay standard-tier paths.

With * text=auto eol=lf, a CRLF page hashes differently from its stored blob while git status calls it clean, and a fresh clone checks it out as LF; next asks git status for commit state and hashes pages as LF.

The stop gate re-judged a lower unmerged PR's complete record on a stacked branch and failed its page order; the hook now takes its base from where this branch's own commits start. A git-log filter would also list a record edited and then restored, so the hook filters by diff.

The task record has no planned status and rejects unknown fields; requirement ids are checked only at handoff, which also asks a partial record its four review questions. The write-ticket stub is partial with named tests in remaining.
Order breaches (code committed before discovery pages) surface only when a record says complete; next has no base and cannot flag them earlier.

discovery_review: Recorded the five material discoveries from the pages and the build; transient review findings stay in reviews.json.

documentation.rationale: ARTIFACTS.md opens the page loop with next and records reviews with verdict; COMPLETION.md names the write-ticket skill and the stacked stop base; README and AGENTS.md step 2 name next.

summary: Add cargo xtask task-artifact next and verdict, which route the task-page loop and log each review with the page's hash in reviews.json; judge a stacked branch's stop from its own commits; add a write-ticket skill for both hosts. The ceremony list stays as it is.
remaining: Write and review buy-in.html and quiz.html after the last product commit.
Run cargo xtask check ci, then complete and handoff against origin/main.
